questions.title: Custom Questions
questions.question: Question
questions.add_custom_description: Add your own question to ask during the interview.
questions.question_placeholder: What would you like to ask?
questions.rationale_placeholder: Why is this question important to you?
questions.no_llm_description: Configure an AI provider in settings to generate company-specific questions.

defaults.gr_1: How many people on the team have been here more than 5 years?
defaults.gr_1_rationale: Reveals retention and team stability, which signals a healthy work environment.
defaults.gr_2: What does career progression look like for this role?
defaults.gr_2_rationale: Shows if there is a clear growth path and whether the company invests in long-term development.
defaults.gr_3: How does the company handle promotions?
defaults.gr_3_rationale: Helps you understand if advancement is merit-based, tenure-based, or ambiguous.
defaults.gr_4: What's the typical tenure on this team?
defaults.gr_4_rationale: Low tenure may indicate dissatisfaction; high tenure suggests people enjoy the work and culture.
defaults.gr_5: Can you tell me about someone who grew significantly here?
defaults.gr_5_rationale: Concrete examples prove the company actually delivers on growth promises.
defaults.tc_1: What are the main technical challenges the team faces?
defaults.tc_1_rationale: Reveals complexity of the work and whether the team tackles interesting problems.
defaults.tc_2: How do you handle technical debt?
defaults.tc_2_rationale: Shows whether the team prioritizes code quality or is always in firefighting mode.
defaults.tc_3: What's your code review process like?
defaults.tc_3_rationale: Indicates quality standards, team collaboration, and how knowledge is shared.
defaults.tc_4: How often do you ship to production?
defaults.tc_4_rationale: Reveals CI/CD maturity and deployment confidence.
defaults.tc_5_rationale: Shows engineering rigor and whether quality is built into the process.
defaults.ob_1: How is the onboarding process structured?
defaults.ob_1_rationale: A well-structured onboarding means faster ramp-up and better support for new hires.
defaults.ob_2: What does the first 90 days look like?
defaults.ob_2_rationale: Sets clear expectations and helps you prepare for early milestones.
defaults.ob_3: Who would be my mentor or buddy?
defaults.ob_3_rationale: Having a go-to person makes the transition smoother and shows the team cares about integration.
defaults.db_1: Do you offer training or certification budgets?
defaults.db_1_rationale: Shows investment in employees' continuous learning and professional growth.
defaults.db_2: Is there time allocated for learning during work hours?
defaults.db_2_rationale: Dedicated learning time shows the company values skill development, not just output.
defaults.db_3: What conferences or events does the team attend?
defaults.db_3_rationale: Indicates industry engagement and networking opportunities.
defaults.db_4: What benefits are most valued by the team?
defaults.db_4_rationale: Gives you real insight into what matters most to current employees.
defaults.tm_1: How does the team communicate day-to-day?
defaults.tm_1_rationale: Reveals collaboration style and whether it aligns with your preferences.
defaults.tm_2_rationale: Helps you assess if the management approach matches what you need to thrive.
defaults.tm_3: How are disagreements or conflicts resolved?
defaults.tm_3_rationale: Healthy conflict resolution is key to a functional team environment.
defaults.tm_4: What do you value most in developers you hire?
defaults.tm_4_rationale: Shows you exactly what traits to emphasize and what the team culture prioritizes.

tips.research_company: Look at the company website, recent news, social media, and employee reviews to understand their mission and values.
tips.review_job_description: Highlight key requirements and prepare specific examples for each one.
tips.prepare_metrics: Numbers and percentages make your achievements tangible and memorable.
tips.practice_star: Practice out loud, not just in your head. Record yourself to improve delivery.
tips.review_pitch: Your pitch should feel natural. Practice it until you can deliver it without thinking.
tips.update_portfolio: Make sure your GitHub, portfolio, or LinkedIn reflect your best and most recent work.
tips.prepare_questions: Having thoughtful questions shows genuine interest and research.
tips.rest_well: A good night's sleep improves cognitive performance, memory, and emotional regulation.
tips.camera_eye_level: Place your laptop on a stack of books or use a stand so the camera is at eye level.
tips.quiet_background: Find a quiet room, close windows, and use a simple or blurred background.
tips.good_lighting: Face a window or place a lamp in front of you. Avoid backlighting.
tips.headphones_tested: Test your headphones before the call. Wired headphones are more reliable than Bluetooth.
tips.test_internet: Run a speed test. Use a wired connection if possible for stability.
tips.test_audio_video: Join a test call in the meeting app to verify everything works.
tips.dress_professionally: Dress as if going to an in-person interview. Yes, even the bottom half - you might need to stand up.
tips.active_listening: Let the interviewer finish their thought before you respond. It shows respect and thoughtfulness.
tips.eye_contact_camera: Look at the camera lens, not the screen, to simulate eye contact.
tips.smile_nod: Natural expressions show engagement and build rapport.
tips.good_posture: Sitting upright projects confidence and keeps you alert.
tips.dont_cross_arms: Open body language signals approachability and confidence.
tips.phone_silent: A buzzing phone is distracting for everyone.
tips.take_notes: Jot down key points or follow-up items. It shows you are engaged.
tips.be_concise: Aim for 1-2 minute answers. Use the STAR method to stay structured.
tips.thank_interviewer: A sincere thank you leaves a positive lasting impression.
tips.reinforce_interest: Briefly restate why you are excited about the role and company.
tips.ask_next_steps: This shows professionalism and helps you plan your follow-up.
tips.ask_anything_else: This ensures you have addressed all their concerns.
tips.send_thank_you: Personalize it by referencing specific topics discussed in the interview.
tips.record_feedback: Write down your impressions while they are fresh.
tips.note_questions_asked: This helps you prepare better for future interviews.
tips.reflect_performance: Honest self-reflection accelerates your interview skills improvement.
tips.follow_up: A polite follow-up email shows continued interest without being pushy.
